data: © NASA/JPL-Caltech — Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter; HiRISE camera resolves objects ≥30 cm on the surface (used to find Beagle 2's wreckage).

MRO's HiRISE camera has a pixel scale of 25 cm — sharp enough to find Beagle 2's wreckage in 2015 and to image Curiosity and Perseverance from orbit. Acts as the primary high-bandwidth relay for surface assets.
Highest-resolution orbital imaging of any planet; the eyes-in-the-sky for every recent Mars surface mission.
